{{Youmay|the spaceport|[[Merisee Prime (company)|the company of the same name]]}}
'''Merisee Prime''' was one of the three primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. It was located outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Caronath]]. It was the largest spaceport on the planet, and was used primarily for passengers, business travelers, and small and medium cargo transportation.
